description: This file defines the TokenStream class used by Twig to represent and manipulate a stream of tokens during template parsing.

classes.name: TokenStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream of tokens for parsing in Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TokenStream with an array of tokens and an optional source object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the token stream into a string by imploding all tokens.

methods.name: injectTokens
methods.description: Injects an array of tokens at the current position in the stream.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the pointer to the next token and returns the previous token.

methods.name: nextIf
methods.description: Tests the current token against given criteria, advances if it matches.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that the current token matches expectations, then advances.

methods.name: look
methods.description: Peeks ahead a certain number of tokens without advancing.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests the current token against given criteria.

methods.name: isEOF
methods.description: Checks if the end of the token stream has been reached.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context associated with the token stream.
